title: Constant after completing the square
source: Theory IGCSE-14.4 Quick check 1 (x^2+10x+28=(x+5)^2+3); book Worked example 16 style p.453, new numbers
stem: Write \(x^2+{B|int}x+{C|int}\) in the form \(\bigl(x+{p|int}\bigr)^2+k\). What is the value of \(k\)?

steps.name: A
steps.note: C = p^2 + k, so the constant after completing the square is k. Spaces avoid adjacent braces.

contexts.note: Includes the original p=5, k=3, giving x^2+10x+28

title: Constant for a completed square with a minus
source: Theory IGCSE-14.4 Quick check 2 (x^2-8x+20=(x-4)^2+4); book Worked example 16 style p.453, new numbers
stem: Write \(x^2-{B|int}x+{C|int}\) in the form \(\bigl(x-{p|int}\bigr)^2+k\). What is the value of \(k\)?

steps.name: A
steps.note: C = p^2 + k. Spaces avoid adjacent braces.

contexts.note: Includes the original p=4, k=4, giving x^2-8x+20

title: The shift in a completed square
source: Theory IGCSE-14.4 Quick check 3 (x^2+12x-5 has p=6); book key observation p.453, new numbers
stem: When \(x^2+{B|int}x-{c|int}\) is written as \((x+p)^2+q\), what is the value of \(p\)?

steps.name: A
steps.note: The number in the bracket is half the coefficient of x.

contexts.note: Includes the original p=6, c=5, giving x^2+12x-5

title: Write a quadratic in completed-square form

source.note: Stem taken from the QP PDF (UCLES 2020), Question 9(a)(i) only. Official answer and mark allocation from the MS PDF. The item is paper/self-mark. The later parts of Question 9 are omitted.

stem:
This question is 0580/42/M/J/20 Question 9(a)(i), taken from the official QP.

Write \(x^2+8x-9\) in the form \((x+k)^2+h\).  [2]

steps.name: B1
steps.text_tex: Half of \(8\) is \(4\), so the squared bracket is \((x+4)^2\).
steps.note: MS: B1 for (x+k)^2 - 9 - (their k)^2 or (x+4)^2 - h, or k=4.

steps.name: B2
steps.note: MS: the completed form is (x+4)^2-25. Independent check: (x+4)^2-25=x^2+8x+16-25=x^2+8x-9.
